About this item

  • Perfect Fit for Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra: Precision-engineered exclusively for your device, this OtterBox case offers a flawless fit. It not only preserves your phone's sleek design but also ensures unparalleled protection against everyday hazards.
  • Superior Drop Protection: Rigorously tested, this case surpasses military standards (MIL-STD-810G 516.6), enduring 5X more drops. Rest assured, your phone is safeguarded in the most unexpected situations with OtterBox's commitment to superior protection.
  • Slim Yet Tough: Experience the perfect balance with a slim profile that comfortably fits in your pocket, coupled with the strength of OtterBox. Made with 50% recycled plastic, this case stands for both eco-conscious durability and uncompromised toughness.
  • Wireless Charging Compatible: Ingeniously designed for modern convenience, this case fully supports wireless charging. Its magnet-free design ensures seamless compatibility, keeping your Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra ready for use at all times.
  • Trusted OtterBox Quality: With OtterBox, you're not just buying a case; you're investing in peace of mind. Our limited warranty covers material and workmanship defects.

Product Description

Legendary durable Galaxy S24 Ultra case, Defender Series, with a multi-layer construction guards your device from serious drops, dirt, scrapes and bumps. Wireless ready, it works with Qi. Plus, the included holster does double duty as a belt clip or hands-free kickstand.


Specifications:

       


    Compatible With:

         
      • Galaxy S24 Ultra .


      Drop Height:

           
        • DROP+ | 5X as many drops as military standard (MIL-STD-810G 516.6) .


        Dimensions:

             
          • 7.04 in x 3.89 in x 1.28 in / 178.79 mm x 98.79 mm x 32.54 mm .


          Weight:

               
            • 0.30 lbs | 136.21 g .


            Materials:

                 
              • Polycarbonate shell .
                 
              • Synthetic rubber slipcover .
                 
              • Polycarbonate holster .


              Case Features:

                   
                • Multi-layer defense features a rubber outer cover for better grip and impact absorption while the rigid inner shell offers extra protection .
                   
                • Durable rubber outer cover provides drop-resistant grip .
                   
                • Port covers block dust and dirt .
                   
                • Bumpers around the camera protect against hard hits .
                   
                • Screen lip keeps display hovering safely off surfaces .
                   
                • Holster clips to bags and packs / Kickstand for hands-free viewing .
                   
                • Wireless charging compatible .
                   
                • Works with OtterBox screen protectors .
                   
                • Fully compatible with 5G networks .
                   
                • Limited lifetime warranty supported by hassle-free customer service. .

                About this Item

                • Perfect Fit for Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra: Precision-engineered exclusively for your device, this OtterBox case offers a flawless fit. It not only preserves your phone's sleek design but also ensures unparalleled protection against everyday hazards.
                • Superior Drop Protection: Rigorously tested, this case surpasses military standards (MIL-STD-810G 516.6), enduring 5X more drops. Rest assured, your phone is safeguarded in the most unexpected situations with OtterBox's commitment to superior protection.
                • Slim Yet Tough: Experience the perfect balance with a slim profile that comfortably fits in your pocket, coupled with the strength of OtterBox. Made with 50% recycled plastic, this case stands for both eco-conscious durability and uncompromised toughness.
                • Wireless Charging Compatible: Ingeniously designed for modern convenience, this case fully supports wireless charging. Its magnet-free design ensures seamless compatibility, keeping your Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra ready for use at all times.
                • Trusted OtterBox Quality: With OtterBox, you're not just buying a case; you're investing in peace of mind. Our limited warranty covers material and workmanship defects.

                Product Description

                Legendary durable Galaxy S24 Ultra case, Defender Series, with a multi-layer construction guards your device from serious drops, dirt, scrapes and bumps. Wireless ready, it works with Qi. Plus, the included holster does double duty as a belt clip or hands-free kickstand.
